decisions.why: Categories are HSE First Aid Kits, Eye Wash, Plasters, Burns Dressings, Conforming Bandages, Adhesive Dressings - a workplace/ambulance first aid range.

NG Tubes/Enteral Feeding confirmed by Ryles Tube example (nutrition:dev); categories Syringes/Needles/Oral Syringes/Blunt Needles (vascular:gen) and Nebuliser Masks (respiratory:aero) are distinct sub-ranges genuinely spanning the division.

Sharpsguard/SHARPSAFE examples confirm sharps bins (infection:sharps); Hand Towel Dispenser/Z-Fold Towels examples confirm washroom hygiene (facilities:washroom); Surface/Vehicle Cleaning and Spills categories confirm cleaning chemicals (facilities:clean).
Manikins and Task Trainers category plus examples of simulated blood/plasma/infusion products used as resuscitation training accessories.
All four examples are adult/paediatric defibrillation pads and electrodes for ZOLL and Defigard devices.
Silicone Foley Catheter example confirms indwelling catheters (continence:ind); Ugo drainage bag with T-tap example confirms drainage bags (continence:dr).
